sloka: सो ऽभिगम्य महात्मानं राघवं शोकलालसम्।वानरांश्चैव ददृशे बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणान् ।। ६.८४.३ ।।
transliteration: so 'bhigamya mahātmānaṁ rāghavaṁ śokalālasam।vānarāṁścaiva dadṛśe bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇān ।। 6.84.3 ।।

translations.english: He (Vibheeshana) saw the great soul, the delight of the Ikshvaku race deluded, distressed, and lying on the lap of Lakshmana.
